ayahOccurrences.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتَ ٱلنَّبِىِّ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ إِلَىٰ طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَٰظِرِينَ إِنَىٰهُ وَلَٰكِنْ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ فَٱدْخُلُوا۟ فَإِذَا طَعِمْتُمْ فَٱنتَشِرُوا۟ وَلَا مُسْتَـْٔنِسِينَ لِحَدِيثٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمْ كَانَ يُؤْذِى ٱلنَّبِىَّ فَيَسْتَحْىِۦ مِنكُمْ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَسْتَحْىِۦ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَإِذَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُنَّ مَتَٰعًا فَسْـَٔلُوهُنَّ مِن وَرَآءِ حِجَابٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَطْهَرُ لِقُلُوبِكُمْ وَقُلُوبِهِنَّ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُؤْذُوا۟ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَن تَنكِحُوٓا۟ أَزْوَٰجَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمْ كَانَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمًا

lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
د/خ/ل   d–kh–l entrance, door, doorway, to enter, to penetrate
; obscurity, secret, confidant; ill feeling, cheating; defects, loneliness; emaciation; to infiltrate, to come in between; guest, outsider.

Of this root, 8 forms occur 126 times in the Qur’an:
دَخَلَ dakhala 75 times; دُخِلَ dukhila 1 time; أَدْخَلَ ʾadkhala 38 times; أُدْخِلَ ʾudkhila 4 times; دَاخِلُون dākhilūn 2 times; مُدْخَلٌ mudkhal 3 times; مُدَّخَلٌ muddakhal 1 time and دَخَلٌ dakhal 2 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
دَخَلَ dakhala u [v. intrans.]

1 to enter, to go into

(18:35) وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ and he went into his garden while he was being unjust to himself [harming his own soul by his conceit and disbelief]

2 [with عَلَى] to enter upon, to force one’s way

(5:23) ادْخُلُوا عَلَيْهِمُ الْبَابَ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُمُوهُ فَإِنَّكُمْ غَالِبُونَ enter in upon them through the gate, for if you enter by it, you will indeed be victorious

3 [with فِي] to join with

(89:29) فَادْخُلِي فِى عِبَادِي join My servants

4 [with prep. ﺒ] to consummate marriage

(4:23) وَرَبَائِبُكُمُ اللاَّتِي فِى حُجُورِكُمْ مِنْ نِسَائِكُمُ اللاَّتِي دَخَلْتُمْ بِهِنَّ and [your] stepdaughters in your care–those born of your women [wives] with whom you have consummated marriage.

entries.label: أَدْخَلَ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَدْخَلَ ʾadkhala [v. IV, trans.; pass. أُدْخِلَ ʾadkhila]

1 to admit, to cause to enter

(42:8) يُدْخِلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِ He admits to His mercy whom He will

2 to put into, to enter something into

(27:12) وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ put your hand inside [the neck of] your cloak.

entries.label: دَاخِلُون
entries.definitionHtml:
دَاخِلُون dākhilūn [pl. of act. part. دَاخِلٌ dākhil] one who enters

(66:10) ادْخُلاَ النَّارَ مَعَ الدَّاخِلِينَ enter, both of you, the Fire along with those who enter.

entries.label: دَخَلٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
دَخَلٌ dakhal [n.] falsehood, deceit, guile, fraud

(16:94) وَلاَ تَتَّخِذُوا أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلاً بَيْنَكُمْ do not use your oaths as a means of deceit between you.

entries.label: دُخِلَ
entries.definitionHtml:
دُخِلَ dukhila [pass. v.] to be entered, to be invaded

(33:14) وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَقْطَارِهَا had it [the city] been entered, [and the enemy came] upon them, from all [its] sides.

entries.label: مُدَّخَلٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مُدَّخَلٌ muddakhal [n. of place] a crevice, hiding place

(9:57) لَوْ يَجِدُونَ مَلْجَأً أَوْ مَغَارَاتٍ أَوْ مُدَّخَلا لَوَلَّوْا إِلَيْهِ وَهُمْ يَجْمَحُونَ if they could find a place of refuge, or some caverns, or somewhere to crawl into, they would bolt away to it in great haste.

entries.label: مُدْخَلٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مُدْخَلٌ mudkhal [v. n./n. of place or time] entering; a place of entering, entrance

(17:80) وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ and say, ‘My Lord, lead me in [lit. with an ingoing of truth] truthfully and lead me out [lit. with an outgoing of truth] truthfully’ (said to be, among other interpretations: in and out of any task, or, situation in which one finds oneself).
